name: airbrake_sourcemaps
description: Airbrake source maps: list, get, delete, upload. sourcemap_id MUST be passed as a string. upload reads a LOCAL source map from file_path (see its constraints; anything else is rejected before any request) and POSTs it as multipart/form-data with name (the minified file URL it applies to) and optional pattern (SQL LIKE pattern for minified file URLs). A failed upload is never re-sent automatically; if its error says it may have been applied, check list before uploading again. List results include `_pagination.has_more`/`next_page`. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed unless list is given `fields` (keeps only those top-level keys per item).

fields.description: List actions only: keep just these top-level keys (exact names as Airbrake returns them, e.g. ["id","createdAt"]) on each listed item. Omit for the full payload.

file_path.description: Absolute local path to the source map. Must end in .map and resolve (symlinks followed) to a regular *.map file of at most 50 MiB containing source map v3 JSON.

name.description: Minified file URL or name this map applies to, e.g. https://cdn.example.com/app.min.js

pattern.description: Optional SQL LIKE pattern matching minified file URLs, e.g. %/app.min.js
